vgmstream.license: COPYING: permissive ISC-style (use/copy/modify/distribute with notice); build-time tool, not shipped
vgmstream.note: tk-build-1: May-2026 decode commit (master @ 2026-05-20; avoids post-May EA-SCHl changes). Residual arch drift: ARM64/Mac builds of this commit decode MicroTalk takes byte-identical to the lane toolchain (brew r2117 May 19 2026), but the x86_64 gate build (Ubuntu clang 18 vs Mac clang 23) drifts +-6 LSB on ~2% of samples, so container speech composites cannot byte-match PB70 (see REPORT 2.3 gap); binary never enters the repo or APK
